title: Context menu item
description: A background plugin that adds "Make uppercase" to the context menu over selected text and replaces the selection when it is clicked.
shows: onContextMenuShow: answer every time with AddContextMenuItem, an empty list included, or the menu waits for the plugin
options.type tells what the menu was opened on (Selection, Target, Image, Shape, OleObject)
events in config.json: onContextMenuClick must be declared there, attachContextMenuClickEvent alone does not subscribe
attachContextMenuClickEvent: one handler per item id
type "background": no window, starts with the editor once enabled (8.1+)
